role: Source-owner factual verification; reviewer authored F561 changes, so this is not independent source review. No translation approval.

callbacks.docstring: Relay backend reports without touching widgets on the worker thread.
Accept only a completion belonging to this screen's current run.

evidence: The progress closure captures a bound signal emitter, emits generation plus int/int/float values, and catches RuntimeError after receiver deletion. It does not read or mutate Qt widgets in the worker callback.
The GUI-connected _on_dino_progress receiver separately rejects closed/inactive/obsolete runs. The callback doc promises relay only and does not incorrectly claim it filters stale reports itself.

Completion closure checks screen-not-closed and exact captured generation before delegating to _on_dino_done. JobRunner supplies settled GUI callback dispatch; this closure makes no stronger claim than current-run acceptance.
validation: Read actual published callback/source and existing meaningful fake-backend/real-thread owning tests; no replay, no model load/training, no generator or helper inventory scan.
